titulo: Cognex (May 2020): $441.5 million to shareholders, about 190 jobs planned cuts. Do the math.
descripcion:
From the archive: May 2020. Not today's news.
Cognex, May 26, 2020 (Cognex, Form 8-K (Item 2.05)): "reduce the Company’s operating costs, optimize its business model"
Cognex's May 2020 8-K approved a restructuring plan with a reduction in force of approximately 190 employees. Its 2020 10-K reports $441.5 million in cash paid for repurchases and dividends.

That same year: $441.5 million to shareholders, 2020, company-wide. $51.036 million of repurchases plus $390.508 million of dividends in 2020, company-wide (cash flow statement, in thousands).
The math: $441.5 million to shareholders, 2020, company-wide ÷ about 190 jobs = $2.32 million to shareholders in 2020 per job cut. The result is approximate.
The facts: $441.5 million to shareholders, 2020, company-wide (Cognex 10-K, FY2020, Feb 11, 2021). about 190 jobs planned cuts (Cognex 8-K, May 2020, May 28, 2020). The $441.5 million is cash paid in 2020 for buybacks and dividends. The dividend line includes a one-time special dividend paid in the fourth quarter. The 190 cuts come from the May 2020 8-K; the payouts come from the 2020 10-K.

Optimize the shareholder column. (Our take.)

Sources:
- Cognex 8-K, May 2020, May 28, 2020: «approved a restructuring plan intended to reduce the Company’s operating costs, optimize its business model and address the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.» and «The restructuring plan includes a global reduction in force of approximately 190 employees and office closures.» https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/851205/000115752320000825/a52227216.htm
- Cognex 10-K, FY2020, Feb 11, 2021: «Repurchase of common stock ( 51,036 ) ( 61,690 ) ( 203,822 ) Payment of dividends ( 390,508 )» https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/851205/000085120521000005/cgnx-20201231.htm
